name: herdr-review
description: Review a repo's changes in a herdr split next to Claude: a filterable file list with diff previews, unified diffs in nvim, file:line comments typed into Claude's input box, and read marks that hold until a file changes. Plus tig in a split for commit history.

auto_open.title: Open the review pane automatically
auto_open.description: Open a live review split next to Claude on its first file edit in a session (inside herdr only). Closing the pane keeps it closed for that session.
